title: Spatial Grounding and Abstract Tripartite Case Metaphors

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Hungarian grammar is deeply grounded in space. The three-way distinction (*honnan? hol? hová?*) applied across internal (*-ból, -ban, -ba*), surface (*-ról, -on, -ra*) and 'near' (*-tól, -nál, -hoz*) endings gives a template for many abstract expressions.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: One way to read these expressions: despair is a container we fall into (*kétségbe esünk*), trust is something placed inside someone (*bízunk benne*), and work is a load carried on a surface (*dolgozunk rajta*). These are illustrations, not proof.
